# Muse/Copilot routing rule — historical personal copy

This repository is a historical personal copy, not the canonical source of truth. For current instructions and all new Berkah POS work, use https://github.com/berkah-pos/Berkahtigaputeri.

Required canonical reads:
1. [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/berkah-pos/Berkahtigaputeri/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
2. [Accepted owner ADR](https://github.com/berkah-pos/Berkahtigaputeri/blob/main/docs/permanent/ADR-2026-10-16-OWNER-ARCHITECTURE-DECISION.md)
3. [DOC_00 configuration contract](https://github.com/berkah-pos/Berkahtigaputeri/blob/main/docs/permanent/DOC_00_CANONICAL_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION.md)
4. [DOC_14 target architecture](https://github.com/berkah-pos/Berkahtigaputeri/blob/main/docs/permanent/DOC_14_KVM2_ISOLATED_TENANT_ARCHITECTURE.md)
5. [Master roadmap](https://github.com/berkah-pos/Berkahtigaputeri/blob/main/docs/permanent/DOC_00_MASTER_ROADMAP.md)
6. [Permanent document/evidence index](https://github.com/berkah-pos/Berkahtigaputeri/blob/main/docs/permanent/README.md)

Do not present this copy's old Supabase-oriented runtime directions as current architecture authority. In the canonical repository, the owner ADR has selected Laravel Central API + PostgreSQL 17, while the checked-in `main` Flutter runtime remains Supabase-backed as of the 2026-10-16 baseline. Source-verified main behavior, accepted design, unmerged PR code, exact-head CI, staging observations and production acceptance are distinct states. Preserve legacy SQL/code/reports as migration evidence until explicit verified cutover and retention approval.
